LOOK: Farmers from Central Luzon and Southern Tagalog, along with their supporters, hold a mobilization against corruption earlier today, Oct. 21, 2025, in Mendiola, Manila. 

The protest is part of a growing people’s movement aimed at exposing corruption, land grabbing, plunder, and extreme government neglect in the countryside. The group is also calling for real land reform. 

COURTESY: Danny Pata
